title: Central Eastern European Parliamentary Study 1992-1994
authors: Dr. P Kopecky, Vakgroep Politieke Wetenschappen, Universiteit Leiden (primary investigator)
contributors: Dr. P Kopecky, Vakgroep Politieke Wetenschappen, Universiteit Leiden (depositor)
descriptions: A comparative study into the institutionalization of parliamentry Democracy in Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic and Slovakia. Members of the respective parliaments were asked to fill in a questionnaire with questions concerning their opinion on the parliamentry system, their background, their work as an MP, representation, political issues etc.
